clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 3.2(a): for exercise of rights granted under the License in jurisdictions where compulsory-scheme royalties cannot be waived, Licensor reserves the exclusive right to collect them.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 3.2(b): for exercises of licensed rights in jurisdictions permitting waiver of compulsory-scheme royalties, Licensor waives the exclusive right to collect them.
clauses.condition_explanation: jurisdiction_allows_compulsory_royalty_waiver means the applicable jurisdiction permits waiver of the right to collect statutory or compulsory licensing royalties. This is a waiver by Licensor, not a licensee payment obligation.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 3.2(c): Licensor waives collection of royalties from exercises of licensed rights under voluntary license schemes, individually or through a collecting society.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.1 makes the Section 3 rights subject to compliance with the following conditions; noncompliance is a material breach.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.2(a): Public Conveyance of the Database, a Derivative Database, or the Database as part of a Collective Database must be only under this License. Public Conveyance excludes mere network interaction without transfer of a copy.

obligation_items.content: Convey the covered database material only under the ODC-By License.
obligation_items.object: Database, Derivative Database, or Database as part of a Collective Database
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever You Publicly Convey any of those covered materials.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.2(b): on covered Public Conveyance, include a copy of the License or its URI with the Database or Derivative Database, both in the material and relevant documentation.
clauses.condition_explanation: publicly_conveys_database_or_derivative_database is the Section 4.2 trigger. The required license copy or URI must accompany both the database material and relevant documentation.

obligation_items.content: Include a copy of the ODC-By License or its URI in the Database or Derivative Database and in relevant documentation.
obligation_items.object: Conveyed Database or Derivative Database and relevant documentation
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever You Publicly Convey the Database, a Derivative Database, or the Database as part of a Collective Database.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.2(c): on covered Public Conveyance, keep intact copyright notices, Database Right notices, and notices referring to the License.

obligation_items.content: Keep intact copyright notices, Database Right notices, and notices referring to the ODC-By License.
obligation_items.object: Notices accompanying conveyed Database or Derivative Database
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever You Publicly Convey the Database, a Derivative Database, or the Database as part of a Collective Database.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.2(d): when file structure prevents placing required notices in a particular file, include them in a location where users are likely to look.

obligation_items.content: Place the required notices in a location where users would be likely to look.
obligation_items.object: Required notices for conveyed Database or Derivative Database
obligation_items.trigger: When the file structure makes it impossible to put required notices in a particular file.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.3: creating and using a Produced Work alone does not require the Section 4.2 notice. If You Publicly Use a Produced Work, include an associated notice reasonably calculated to inform exposed persons that Content came from the Database, Derivative Database, or Database in a Collective Database and is available under this License.
clauses.condition_explanation: publicly_uses_produced_work is the trigger; mere creation and use without Public Use does not trigger this notice. The notice must identify the source category and availability under the License and be associated with the Produced Work.

obligation_items.content: Include a notice associated with the Produced Work, reasonably calculated to make persons who use, view, access, interact with, or are otherwise exposed to it aware that its Content was obtained from the covered Database material and is available under ODC-By.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever You Publicly Use a Produced Work containing Content obtained from the Database, a Derivative Database, or the Database as part of a Collective Database.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.4: You may not sublicense the Database. The Licensor separately offers recipients the same-terms license when You communicate covered material; those rules and the further-restrictions prohibition are extracted separately.
clauses.condition_explanation: The no-sublicense rule is unqualified for the Database.

obligation_items.trigger: At all times when exercising rights under the License.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.4: each communication to another of the Database, the whole or a Substantial part of Contents, or a Derivative Database triggers the Licensor's offer of a same-terms license to the recipient. clauses.condition_explanation: Trigger is any communication to anyone else of one of the listed materials. The same-terms license offer is made by Licensor to recipient; the licensee has no enforcement duty.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.4: You are not responsible for enforcing third-party compliance with the License; You may enforce rights You have over a Derivative Database.
clauses.condition_explanation: This states no duty to enforce third-party compliance and an optional enforcement right over rights You hold in a Derivative Database.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.4: You are solely responsible for modifications to a Derivative Database made by You or another Person at Your direction.
clauses.condition_explanation: The responsibility attaches only to modifications made by You or by another Person at Your direction.

obligation_items.content: Accept sole responsibility for modifications to a Derivative Database made by You or by another Person at Your direction.
obligation_items.trigger: When You or a Person acting at Your direction makes those modifications.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 4.4: You may not impose further restrictions on exercise of rights granted or affirmed under this License.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition concerns further restrictions on the exercise of rights granted or affirmed by the License.

obligation_items.content: Do not impose further restrictions on exercise of rights granted or affirmed under ODC-By.
obligation_items.object: Rights granted or affirmed under ODC-By
obligation_items.trigger: When communicating covered material or otherwise imposing terms affecting exercise of licensed rights.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 5.1(a): Licensor waives Database moral rights to the fullest extent possible where the relevant jurisdiction allows waiver.
clauses.condition_explanation: jurisdiction_allows_moral_rights_waiver means the governing relevant jurisdiction permits waiver of moral rights; scope is limited to the fullest extent permitted by that law.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 5.1(b): if waiver is not possible but an agreement not to assert is possible, Licensor agrees not to assert moral rights over the Database and waives claims to the fullest extent permitted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The alternative applies where waiver under Section 5.1(a) is impossible but nonassertion is legally possible; any claims waiver is limited by applicable law.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 5.1(c): where neither waiver nor agreement not to assert is allowed, the author may retain moral rights over certain aspects of the Database.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies in jurisdictions not allowing either of the alternatives in Sections 5.1(a) and (b); the text recognizes possible retained rights, not an affirmative duty.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 6.1: License does not affect uses independently permitted under applicable law.
clauses.condition_explanation: Permission is limited to rights independently available under applicable law; it is not a new license grant.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 6.1(a): preserves independently available Database Right exceptions, including extraction from non-electronic Databases for private purposes, illustration for teaching or scientific research, and public security or administrative or judicial proceedings.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed exceptions are examples of rights independently available under applicable law; the License does not itself create an exception where law does not provide one.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 6.1(b): preserves fair dealing, fair use, or other legally recognised limitations or exceptions to infringement of copyright or other applicable laws.
clauses.condition_explanation: Permission depends on an independently applicable legal limitation or exception; the clause does not create one.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By Section 6.2: lawful users may Extract and Re-utilise quantitatively or qualitatively insubstantial Contents for any purpose, including creating a Derivative Database, subject to other rights over Contents; repeated and systematic acts may amount to dealing with a Substantial part.
clauses.condition_explanation: The material must remain insubstantial quantitatively and qualitatively; repeated and systematic extraction or reutilisation that amounts to a Substantial part falls outside this stated permission. Other rights over Contents remain unaffected.
